title: Support Vector Machines
motto: Find the widest street between two classes. That is the entire idea.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Find the widest street between two classes. That is the entire idea.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You have two classes of data points and need to draw a line (or hyperplane) separating them. Infinitely many lines could work. Which one should you pick?

The one with the biggest margin. The margin is the distance between the decision boundary and the nearest data points on each side. A wider margin means the classifier is more confident and generalizes better to unseen data.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: SVMs maximize the margin between classes. Support vectors are the points that define the boundary.
